condition: With the localizedFormat plugin, format('l'/'ll'/'lll'/'llll') on the 'en' locale can throw "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replace')" because the English formats are missing the lowercase tokens. Some setups have reported it, for example when all locales are loaded or in N
workaround: Use the uppercase tokens (L, LL, LLL, LLLL) or explicit format strings like 'M/D/YYYY'. You can also add l/ll/lll/llll to the en locale's formats, as PR #2282 does.
